items.title: `kit::text_input`: a blinking caret, and a drag held still past the field's edge that keeps scrolling (both need a host timer)
items.discussion: left out by lane ui-capture (Order 58, 2026-11-12) as not clean today; split from F172 at its close
items.body: The blink needs: window focus tracked in the host (winit's `Focused` is ignored now); a host-owned blink deadline merged into `shell.rs`'s `wait_for` beside the program's deadline and F169's drain wake; a caret-visible flag that repaints only the edited text (touches F170's scene caching); the blink phase reset on every edit; a shell with an injectable clock so the pin has no timing in it. Budget: an idle unfocused window draws nothing, a focused input at most two frames a second. The same timer serves auto-scroll while a drag is held still past the edge.

items.title: `std::ui` scroll: the doc says a scroll's child never shrinks to the viewport, but nothing enforces it (a text input wrapped, the virtual list works around it)
items.kind: design question (native UI; layout contract) — OWNER RULING
items.discussion: found by lane ui-capture (Order 58, 2026-11-12): a long value with spaces in `kit::text_input` wrapped onto a second line because the field's stack shrank inside the horizontal scroll; fixed in the kit with `.shrink(0.0)`; `ui/kit/lists.vl` carries the same workaround
items.area: vilan/std/src/ui.vl (`scroll_style`), crates/vilan-rt-gfx/src/ui (taffy style of a scroll's child)
items.body: Flexbox shrinks a child to its container along the main axis by default, and R4 put flex semantics under our own vocabulary. For a scroll that default is never wanted along its scroll axis. QUESTION for the owner: should a scroll force `shrink(0)` on its one child along the axis it scrolls (and remove the two kit workarounds)? Integrator's recommendation: yes; it is the contract the doc already states, and both components built so far needed it. Related open default from P2: `Align` stretch plus shrink 1.
